evidence_class: PROJECTION FROM OWNER-REPORTED SCORES AND A LOCAL SIMULATOR; NOT A SCORE, NOT ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED, NOT A LEADERBOARD FORECAST
formula: DTI = T/(0.2*(T+S-M)+0.8*(|G|-T)) with M~T for sparse dots => DTI = d*S/(0.2S+0.8|G|)
holdout_arm_density_caveat: HOLDOUT-DTI measures recovery of withheld *catalogue* components in a simulator that measured Spearman -0.10 against the owner-reported board in round R4; it is not a density estimate for hidden off-catalogue expert-drawn truth.
